jewelry-store.definition: A shop that sells jewelry such as rings, necklaces, and bracelets.

pharmacy.definition: A shop or service where medicines are dispensed and health products are sold.

directory.definition: A map or list showing the mall's shops and facilities.

bench.definition: A long seat for several people.

exit.definition: A doorway or route used to leave the building.

line.definition: A queue of people waiting for their turn.

cinema.definition: A place where people watch films on a large screen.

lost-and-found.definition: A service that stores lost belongings so their owners can claim them.

stroller.definition: A small wheeled chair used to transport a baby or young child.

stamp.definition: A small adhesive label or printed mark showing that postage has been paid.

label.definition: A paper or adhesive tag showing a parcel's address or other details.

address.definition: The details identifying where a letter or parcel should be delivered.

counter.definition: A service surface where postal staff assist customers.

pickup.definition: The collection of a letter or parcel from a specified location.

clerk.definition: A postal worker who assists customers at the service counter.

courier.definition: A worker who collects and delivers parcels or documents.

cart.definition: A wheeled trolley used to move letters or parcels.

scanner.definition: A device that reads a parcel's barcode to record or track it.

box.definition: A container, usually made of cardboard, used to pack items for mailing.

form.definition: A document with spaces for customers to enter postal-service information.

queue.definition: A line of people waiting for their turn.

syrup.definition: A sweetened liquid medicine taken by mouth.

cream.definition: A soft preparation applied to the skin for treatment or care.

eye-drops.definition: A liquid preparation placed in the eyes for treatment or lubrication.

inhaler.definition: A device that delivers medicine into the airways as a person breathes in.

injection.definition: The administration of a substance into the body using a needle.

patch.definition: An adhesive preparation worn on the skin to deliver medicine.

lozenge.definition: A small medicated tablet that dissolves slowly in the mouth.

blister-pack.definition: Packaging with separate sealed pockets for individual tablets or capsules.

nasal-spray.definition: A liquid preparation sprayed into the nose.

ear-drops.definition: A liquid medicine intended to be placed in the ear canal.

injection-pen.definition: A pen-shaped device used to inject a measured dose of medicine.

prescription-counter.definition: The service counter where prescriptions are submitted or medicines are dispensed.

mortar-and-pestle.definition: A bowl and a hand tool used together to crush or mix substances.

label-printer.definition: A device that prints labels with medicine or patient information.

patient-profile.definition: A pharmacy record containing relevant patient and medication information.

plaster.definition: A small adhesive dressing used to cover a minor wound.

cotton-ball.definition: A small soft ball of cotton used for applying products or cleaning skin.

antibiotic.definition: A medicine used to treat or prevent certain bacterial infections.

antihistamine.definition: A medicine that blocks the effects of histamine and can relieve allergy symptoms.

body-lotion.definition: A liquid or creamy product applied to moisturize body skin.

sunscreen.definition: A product applied to skin to help protect it from ultraviolet radiation.

supplement.definition: A product taken in addition to food to supply nutrients or other dietary substances.

probiotic.definition: A product containing live microorganisms intended to have health benefits.

laxative.definition: A medicine used to help relieve constipation.

cough-syrup.definition: A liquid medicine intended to relieve coughing.

cleaner.definition: A worker whose job is to clean the pharmacy.

pill.definition: A small solid dose of medicine taken by mouth.

label.definition: A tag showing a medicine's name, instructions, and other required details.

counter.definition: A service surface where pharmacy staff assist customers.

prescription.definition: An authorized prescriber's instruction for a patient's medicine.

dosage.definition: The amount of a medicine to take and the schedule for taking it.

consultation.definition: A discussion with a pharmacist or other professional to obtain advice.

refill.definition: Another supply of an existing prescription medicine when authorized.

insurance.definition: An arrangement that covers specified healthcare costs under a policy.
